sampler_patch.scope: Instance-only source copy; original module/class/shared files are unchanged

profile.inference: Native cached block Euler ODE; FP16 model+decoder; instance-only two-conditional style branch; no adapters or waveform normalization
profile.branch_semantics: Identical lyric prefix tensor values and generated latent history; separate style-conditioned KV caches; bad branch is not unconditional
profile.beta_zero: Pure good conditional; no negative ODE evaluation. Negative prefix/history caches are still built by native structure.
profile.seed_protocol: External Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA reset after conditioning; native seed argument unused; all initial block noise hashes compared on common prefix; decoder seed42 in fork_rng
profile.scope: External public model feasibility experiment only; no company codec, no trained reward, no RL improvement claim
profile.reproducibility: Within-run same-seed noise equality required; sham PCM/latent equality checked; no cross-hardware bitwise guarantee

tracks.good_style: An intimate indie pop song with female lead vocals, 88 BPM, acoustic guitar, piano, warm electric bass, and live drums. Close-miked human female singing with clear consonants, natural breathing and dynamic phrasing, distinct live-drum attacks and transparent acoustic-guitar and piano detail. Keep the acoustic guitar, piano, electric bass and live drums.
